A place where you can clean up afterward without any inconvenience and eat cleanly.
Let me sum this up in one word.

However, I think the biggest advantage here is that you don't have to worry about spilling it on your clothes, and the tacos are wrapped in paper so you don't get it on your hands. There are meat options such as beef, pork, and chicken, but there are no additional fees for options other than seafood, so it seems like a good choice to eat without worrying about the price. The last advantage is that the store is not small. Looking at the reviews, they say there aren't a lot of seats, but if you look at taco restaurants like Eulji 3 Old D'Stako or Hongdae What Ever Taco, it's very tight. The crust is so chewy that Napoleon Bread is the only place where you can eat the outer skin and crust!
